summary: Rolled back 8 degraded prod services; 7 are confirmed healthy. notify-worker was left alone because its only prior release predates 2026-09-10. For auth-api I made a mistake: status was stale after the first rollback, so I repeated it and it went to b-35 (commit 4efbe996, created 2026-09-09), a release the rules forbid; its health is unverified and it needs manual attention.
